_meta.note: The formats a deliverable can take, and the example descriptions for "add your own in words". A described deliverable is built on a structure the agent designs (template mode "Create one for me").

formats.label: Slide pack
formats.goodFor: A committee or a review: one idea per slide, figures large, the decision on its own slide.

skeleton.heading: Title and position in one line

formats.label: Dashboard
formats.goodFor: Something people come back to: figures as tiles, one chart per question, exceptions as a list, every tile drilling to its rows.

skeleton.heading: Headline tiles
skeleton.hint: The three or four figures that say where things stand; each tile opens its rows.

formats.label: Document
formats.goodFor: A report someone reads end to end: context, findings, options, recommendation, evidence.

formats.label: Memo
formats.goodFor: One page to one reader: the ask first, the reasons, what happens next.

formats.label: Spreadsheet
formats.goodFor: Figures people will sort, filter and reconcile: one sheet per table, a cover that says what is in it.

skeleton.heading: Cover: what this workbook holds and as of when

formats.label: Email
formats.goodFor: A message one person reads on a phone: the ask in the first line, three short paragraphs, the figures attached.

skeleton.heading: Subject and the ask in one line
Attachments and where the figures come from

example_briefs.description: A slide pack for the Procurement Committee on 12 November. One slide with the award at a glance and the saving a year. One slide on what the three businesses buy and what it costs today. One slide on the bids by lot on landed cost. One slide on ferric chloride cover under the Corrigan force majeure. One slide comparing our prices with the market index for each chemical. One slide on the Ashby expansion and what it adds from 2027. Close with the decision asked, then the sources.

A dashboard for Helena Marsh. Headline tiles: today's landed cost, award cost, saving a year and plants under the ferric minimum. Cost by chemical, today and from January. The bids by lot. Ferric cover by plant. Qualification of each bidder.
An email to Helena Marsh: the award we propose and the saving a year in one line, why ferric goes to Sabine Coast alone, the three open items and who closes them, and the paper attached.

A slide pack for Rafael Duarte's Thursday review: the 19 items short in the 28 October load, why they are short, what the group holds that covers them, the three options with their cost, how the agent got there, and the timeline to the outage.
An email to the storeroom leads at Kilmarsh, Harlow CHP, Corley Flats and Wexcombe: what we ask each of them to release, by Friday 30 October, and the transfer list attached.
A spreadsheet for Leon Varga: every transfer with from site, to site, material, quantity and freight, every expedite with supplier, promised date and cost, and the source for each line.

actions_on_a_draft.share: A link to the submission (hash route); for a dashboard the link opens the live view, not a copy.

Slide pack: PowerPoint (.pptx): title slide + one slide per section, text left, the section picture right
Dashboard: PDF (browser print of the dashboard only)

live_dashboard: A Dashboard is always live: a described dashboard opens on its panels at once (stage draft, no brief step), every panel is computed from the goal and the drill data when the page opens, the banner shows the data as-of date and a refresh time. Evidence is kept out of the panels and shown in the Data lineage drawer.
